verdict.rationale: Databricks is built for bulk/batch data processing at scale — Spark-based ETL pipelines, Auto Loader for incremental bulk ingestion, structured streaming, and Unity Catalog governance operate across massive datasets, while the CLI, SDK, and REST APIs let automation scripts perform operations across many jobs/tables/workspaces programmatically. Runtime evidence confirms the CLI supports a raw REST wrapper and scriptable workspace/compute/pipeline commands for automation at scale. Missing for 10: a documented example specifically showing bulk operations across many discrete items (e.g., bulk grant/revoke across hundreds of tables, bulk job trigger) rather than general batch-processing/automation framing.
